name: My Zypp Stikks 1g Infused Preroll - Lemon Cherry
description:
Infused and ready to spark. The My Zypp Stikks Lemon Cherry is a 1-gram infused pre-roll packed with quality flower for a bolder, more potent smoke. No grinding, no rolling, just light it and go.

Lemon Cherry brings a bright, fruit-forward profile: sweet ripe cherry up front with zesty lemon citrus and a smooth, subtly creamy finish.

1G infused pre-roll — quality flower infused for extra potency
Signature Lemon Cherry flavor — sweet cherry with zesty lemon and a creamy finish
Ready to enjoy — no setup, no battery, just light and go

My Zypp Stikks Lemon Cherry is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
